response.name: Daily Research Brief
response.description: Produce a bounded research brief from selected scholarly providers with screening, extraction, synthesis, verification, and human review gates.

response.name: Data Extraction
response.description: Extract structured data from the RAG store according to a user-defined schema, validate against the schema and source grounding, and export as a JSON dataset.

response.name: Evidence Synthesis
response.description: Search configured academic sources, extract claims and supporting evidence, build an evidence map, verify grounding, and export a synthesis report.

response.name: Systematic Literature Review
response.description: Conduct a systematic literature review following PRISMA-like methodology: search multiple academic databases, screen results by inclusion/exclusion criteria, extract key data, synthesize findings, verify grounding, and export a structured report.
